scripts.check: cargo check && pnpm --dir frontend run build
scripts.test: cargo test && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:frontend
scripts.quality:tools: npm run quality:clippy && npm run quality:eslint && npm run quality:machete
scripts.quality: npm run quality:tests && npm run test:report && npm run benchmark && node scripts/tests/quality-review.mjs --root . --require-tools --require-evidence --test-report reports/quality/bridge-tests.xml
scripts.quality:full: npm test && node scripts/tests/check-file-size.mjs && npm run quality:tools && npm run quality
scripts.quality:install: pnpm install && python -m venv .quality-venv && .quality-venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-quality.txt && rustup component add clippy && cargo install cargo-machete --locked
